title: Ninja D4

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Studds Ninja D4 pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1124g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~97 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Light open face with flip-up visor for daily commute.

variants.title: Studds Ninja D4 Matte Black
variants.description: The Studds Ninja D4 is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Light open face with flip-up visor for daily commute.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Studds's Open Face lineup, the Ninja D4 brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Studds Ninja D4 represents Studds's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Studds Ninja D4 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Studds Ninja D4 Matte Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Studds Ninja D4 in Studds Ninja D4 Matte Black. An authentic open-face helmet engineered for urban commuters and custom bike riders who prioritize airflow, visibility, and timeless aesthetics.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Intermediate Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.

Featherweight shell construction eliminates neck fatigue on casual rides
Plush, fully removable and washable moisture-wicking crown liner
real_world_cons: Open-face configuration lacks lower chin bar impact protection
Elevated cockpit wind noise at highway speeds requires earplugs
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Studds Ninja D4 is a benchmark Open Face helmet, engineered to deliver verified safety and all-day acoustic comfort.

qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Wide-vision jet shield with opti-clear optical clarity and optional peak sun deflection.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
